dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep, smooth concavity fitting a parabolic spline that curves inward from the posterior base towards the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin contour presents a steep, slightly convex slope at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum pixel base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.6:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple irregular notches present along the distal half of the trailing edge; a distinct white linear scar or rake mark is visible on the upper third of the fin's lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white punctate speckling distributed across the dark epidermal surface of the fin and the visible dorsal back.
